# FDG7050

> DO throw `OperationCanceledException` to represent any caller-initiated abort or cancellation.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 7.3.9 OperationCanceledException and TaskCanceledException.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether an abort is caller-initiated is judgment. CA2250 is not mapped: it asks for ThrowIfCancellationRequested instead of a check and a throw, which keeps the exception type.
